1906年4月20日，旧金山与奥克兰的日本侨民各自成立救济组织并在当日合并为Japanese Relief Association，自行照料在美同胞；日本方面通过本地委员会与美国全国红十字会捐赠近25万美元。同期救济调查记载社区存在“anti-Japanese feeling of a small but aggressive part of the community”，显示侨民组织网络与排斥情绪并存。

fact: 南满洲铁道株式会社（满铁）依1906年6月7日帝国敕令第142号授权设立：该公司章程第一条自述“This company shall be called the South Manchuria Railway Joint Stock Company and is established in accordance with Imperial Ordinance No. 142 of 1906”；公司于1906年正式成立，以接管俄国原南满铁路并沿线开拓聚落与产业为宗旨，首任总裁为台湾总督出身的后藤新平（1906年11月13日就任），总社先设东京、1907年迁大连。这是日本战后在满洲铺开的国策会社起点。

sources.quote: ARTICLE 1. - This company shall be called the South Manchuria Railway Joint Stock Company and is established in accordance with Imperial Ordinance No. 142 of 1906 and in obedience to the Order of the Imperial Japanese Government. ARTICLE 2. - The liability of the shareholders of this company is limited to the value of the shares owned by them. ARTICLE 3. - This company shall establish its head-office at Tokyo and its branch office at Tairen [Dalian].

fact: 1906年《铁路国有法》（鉄道国有法，明治39年法律第17号）开启了日本铁路的国家收购：该法由第22届帝国议会于1906年3月27日通过，天皇3月30日签署，3月31日刊于官报公布；众议院原案列32家私营铁路，3月27日贵族院修正删除15家后两院通过。1906年10月至1907年10月间，政府依该法从17家私营铁路公司收购干线2,812英里（4,525公里），国铁网增至约4,400英里；其中最大的单笔为1906年11月1日收购日本铁路（Nippon Railway）860.8英里（1,385.3公里）。对私人股东的补偿约为实缴资本的两倍。这是1906年日本最大规模的国有化资本转移。

sources.quote: The Railway Nationalization Act (Tetsudo Kokuyu-ho; Act No. 17 of 1906) was a law enacted by the Diet of Japan that brought many of Japan's private railway lines under national control. The 22nd Diet passed the bill on March 27, 1906 and Emperor Meiji signed on March 30, 1906. The promulgation of the act on the Official Gazette occurred the next day. ... Between 1906 and 1907, 2,812 miles (4,525 km) of track were purchased from 17 private railway companies. ... November 1, 1906: Nippon Railway, 860.8 mi / 1,385.3 km ... December 1, 1906: Sanyo Railway, 414.9 mi / 667.7 km

fact: 满铁以2亿日元资本金成立，为半官半民结构：政府持股50%，其余面向民间募集，是当时日本规模最大的公司资本安排之一，用于铁路运营及沿线聚落与产业开发。至1908年公司资产1.63亿日元，1930年超过10亿日元，常年年回报率25%—45%，成为日本最大的企业。

sources.quote: Under the authorization of Emperor Meiji, Japan then established a new semi-privately held company, the South Manchurian Railway Company (a.k.a. Mantetsu), with a capitalization of 200 million yen to operate the railroad and to develop settlements and industries along its route. ... Owner: Government of Japan (50%) ... Company assets rose from 163 million yen in 1908 to over a billion yen in 1930. Mantetsu was by far the largest corporation in Japan, and also its most profitable, averaging rates of return from 25 to 45 percent per year.

fact: 满铁接管的原俄国铁路经历两次轨距改造：俄人1898—1903年按5英尺（1,524毫米）俄式宽轨修建长春—旅顺干线；日俄战争中日军为使用国内车辆临时改为3英尺6英寸（1,067毫米）窄轨；满铁取得线路后再次改轨为4英尺8.5英寸（1,435毫米）标准轨，以便与中国其他铁路联运。运营初期大量使用美国产钢轨、信号设备，并使用美国机车制造公司（Alco）邓克克工厂生产的蒸汽机车；至1907年底雇用日本人9,000人、中国人4,000人，1910年增至35,000人与25,000人。

sources.title: Wikipedia — South Manchuria Railway（History 节；引 Luis Jackson, Rambles in Japan and China, Railway and Locomotive Engineering vol.26 (1913)；Coox, Nomonhan）
sources.quote: One of the first tasks of the new company was to change the railway gauge. The rail line was originally built according to the gauge of 5ft (1,524mm), during the war it had been converted by the advancing Japanese troops to the Japanese 3ft6in (1,067mm) gauge, in order to facilitate the use of rolling stock brought from Japan. But once the new Japanese South Manchuria Railway Company took possession of the line, it had the tracks re-gauged again, now to the gauge of 4ft8+1/2in (1,435mm) standard gauge ... The railway used a significant amount of U.S.-made rails and signaling equipment, as well as some steam locomotives built by the American Locomotive Company at Dunkirk, NY. ... By the end of 1907, the company employed 9,000 Japanese and 4,000 Chinese. By 1910, those numbers had increased to 35,000 and 25,000 respectively.
